research_design.summary: Git holds normative task/dependency and durable evidence state; GitHub carries lease, implementation, supersession, and exact-head review events. Claims are per-task leases with deterministic comment-id arbitration and explicit stale recovery.

tdd.notes: Initial import-harness RED was corrected before production implementation. Subsequent adversarial review findings were converted into dedicated regression suites before fixes.

result: Parallel agents enumerate all ready work, arbitrate task-local leases deterministically, fail closed on stale/conflicting/malformed coordination state, enforce one implementation workstream or explicit supersession, recheck dependencies before completion, require exact-head review by a distinct session, and store new completion/blocker evidence per task.
